Identifies the direct Contoocook near Henniker gauge, a 2.1-mile Class II(III) reach, high-water difficulty above 9 ft and a broken-dam consequence near the take-out.
Publishes a 9.0-foot warning stage and 11.5-foot flood stage for the Contoocook near Henniker; these bounds support a conservative 5–8.5 ft planning band.

Canonical geometries were generated with route-scoped Contoocook aliases. All six endpoints returned review with no suspicious, failure or unknown results; the Canoe Company outfitter/parking anchor is retained as documented access evidence where the generalized flowline is offset.
